你是英语学习卡片的内容编辑。依据本卡目标词逐条制作内容，目标词集合必须原样保留；同一词允许复习，不新增主归属、不删除或替换目标词。不是要求所有英语句子严格仅用 Basic 850；允许必要的辅助词，但不计入850覆盖。
输出：1 场景与明确画面证据；2 每个目标词的本卡词义、词性、英美音标、自然搭配、短例句与中文、annotation_mode（object/action/relation/context）、evidence；3 图像生成提示词；4 主配文及中文，约8～18个英文词，优先自然、易懂，必要时用2～3句短对话；5 逐词覆盖检查与未完成项。
具体词标到物体，动作词标到动作，空间关系用真实对象关系或双幅对比；功能词与抽象词必须有包含该词或明确屈折形式的自然句子和语境，不给虚假的物体框。所有目标词都有独立可查的词条，即使主配文没有包含它。语法词在词句中高亮，不把冠词标成物体。
主配文草案均为原创，不冒充名著或名言。若要求文学配文，先找可核实的原文，提供作者、作品、原文位置、来源URL及使用依据。不得只根据作者去世就断言可商用；单独核查英文原文、所选版本和译文。改写必须标记 adaptation，原创译文标记 original_translation。查不到出处就使用原创句。无需每张都放名言，更不硬凑所有目标词到一条名言里。
音标和释义需按本卡词义重新核对，不能把源仓库的未经复核数据当成成品。坐标仅在最终图生成后设置；现在可给位置建议，不声称已有精确框选。输出status=content_draft，图片完成并逐词核对后才能改为approved。

image_prompt: Refined photorealistic Korean cool Instagram fashion editorial photograph, vertical 4:5. Stylish East Asian adult woman around 25, sophisticated understated clothes, loose dark low bun, natural pores and subtle high-end magazine retouch, anatomically real hands, true materials. Cool soft window daylight, pearl white and slate palette, coherent single scene, important teaching props clearly readable and separated, calm space near image borders for later annotation. No text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermark or UI. Close environmental portrait at a sewing table, woman face in upper third, hands and repair patch large and sharp in lower half. Repairing a small round HOLE in pale linen garment laid FLAT on table, hole reveals darker table beneath. One real metal sewing NEEDLE threaded with muted BLUE THREAD held in right hand just above cloth, needle eye and length readable, no duplicate needles. A short row of three distinct BLUE STITCHES beside hole, one SMALL visible blue thread KNOT at beginning of stitches. Separate large open metal SCISSORS on table right with two blades and two finger loops. One separate pearl-headed straight PIN on table left away from cloth. Realistic coherent fingers, no sewing machine, no lettering. Make small teaching details unusually clear but physically plausible.
